as_told.title: NASA Saturn program as a transplant of the Nazi space program

plain: NASA's Saturn rocket program, which built the giant rockets for the American Moon missions, was in effect the Nazi German space program moved to the United States. That is how Michels puts it in three different episodes: the German rocket engineers Wernher von Braun and Arthur Rudolph, together with 129 Nazi scientists, were "literally" the whole program. Michels tells it himself without naming a source, once calling the idea a "conspiracy" and leaving out the figure of 129, and he raises it to show how much secret wartime knowledge shaped American technology.
